rules.title: PHP remote code execution via out-of-memory state corruption
rules.description: php-src rates it Critical (CVSS 4.0 9.2): an out-of-memory error during multipart request parsing leaves request memory in an invalid state that shutdown then processes. php-src confirms it on Apache mod_php before any application code runs, finds FPM susceptible by source analysis, and FrankenPHP and LSAPI likely susceptible. Updating is the only complete mitigation; memory_limit=-1 is a partial workaround. Fixed in 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12; published 21 Oct 2026. PHP's security advisory of 21 Oct 2026 (https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5) lists every web SAPI as at risk (PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed), the risk highest for mod_php, and says Linux distributions and LTS vendors received the patches in advance, so distribution packages are fixed under their own version numbers.

rules.title: PHP remote code execution via stale global state (use after free across requests)
rules.description: php-src rates it Critical (CVSS 4.0 9.2): worker-global state that points into a freed request heap is read by the next request on the same worker before initialization resets it. Fixed in 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12; published 21 Oct 2026. PHP's security advisory of 21 Oct 2026 (https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5) lists every web SAPI as at risk (PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed), the risk highest for mod_php, and says Linux distributions and LTS vendors received the patches in advance, so distribution packages are fixed under their own version numbers.

rules.title: PHP-CGI argument injection on Windows (bypass of CVE-2012-1823)
rules.condition: PHP runs as CGI (php-cgi, for example through Apache with an Action/SetHandler to php-cgi) on Windows, where code-page conversion of the query string re-enables argument injection
rules.description: Reported by Orange Tsai (DEVCORE). The php-src advisory rates it High and lists the patched versions 8.1.29, 8.2.20 and 8.3.8 (PHP 8 ChangeLog, 6 June 2024).

rules.title: PHP-CGI parameter injection on Windows (bypass of CVE-2024-4577)
rules.condition: PHP runs as CGI on Windows with a non-standard code-page setting (the ACP code page pointed at an OEM code page in the registry), which php-src calls unlikely in a real environment
rules.description: The php-src advisory rates it Moderate and lists the patched versions 8.1.30, 8.2.24 and 8.3.12 (PHP 8 ChangeLog, 26 September 2024).

rules.title: Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50
rules.condition: Files outside Alias-like directories are not protected by the default "require all denied"; remote code execution also needs CGI enabled for those paths
rules.description: CVE-2021-41773 affected only 2.4.49 and its fix in 2.4.50 was incomplete (CVE-2021-42013), so 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 are affected and 2.4.51 fixes both, per the Apache HTTP Server 2.4 vulnerabilities page.
